failures.observation: all 13 tests in candidate-admission.test.ts failed; no other file in the suite produced a failure; 189 = 202 - 13
failures.single_observed_error: Candidate admission refused: admission root must be a private owned real directory
source_guards: packages/verification/src/candidate-admission.ts:73 - privateDirectory() rejects any root that is not an absolute real non-symlink directory with POSIX mode group/world bits clear (info.mode & 0o077) === 0 and st_uid equal to the process uid. Windows cannot satisfy POSIX ownership/mode semantics.
packages/verification/src/candidate-admission.ts:45 - boundedGit() throws 'bounded Linux Git importer is unavailable' whenever process.platform !== 'linux'.
packages/verification/src/candidate-admission.ts:49 - the bounded importer spawns /usr/bin/prlimit and /usr/bin/git, which do not exist on Windows.
failures.documented_design: docs/verification.md declares this path requires Linux /usr/bin/git and /usr/bin/prlimit, an existing owner-only real admission directory and an operator-owned repository map.
failures.conclusion: The 13 failures are the designed fail-closed behaviour of a Linux-only source boundary executed on Windows. They are not evidence that the candidate-admission source is broken, and they are not evidence that it works on Linux from this host. Linux execution of these 13 tests was not available locally and remains UNVERIFIED_FROM_THIS_HOST.
